headlines.title: Demonstranter i Venezuela vil ha opposisjonsleder hjem
Venezuelans rally for opposition leader’s return and presidential elections
Venezuela’s Oil Comeback Could Cost More Than $100 Billion
Venezuela's Oil Comeback Could Cost More Than $100 Billion - oilprice.com
Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Venezuela has released dozens of political prisoners as calls for elections grow. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR VENEZUELA
The release of political prisoners amid growing election calls occurs while Venezuela has a Country Instability Index score of 50 of 100, in the Normal band. [5][E1]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Venezuela, "Will María Corina Machado enter Venezuela by December 31?", priced Yes at 53% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E7]
A Kalshi market related to Venezuela, "Will Delcy Rodríguez be the head of state of Venezuela on Dec 31, 2026?", priced Yes at 23% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Dec 31, 2026. [E5]

WATCH ITEMS
It is unresolved whether the opposition leader for whose return Venezuelans are rallying will actually return. [1][2]
It is unresolved whether presidential elections will be held in Venezuela. [2]
